sections.overview: The 1991 French description named the Trombetas pike cichlid Crenicichla tigrina. FishBase now accepts Lugubria tigrina. Its related L. strigata is the other revised Lugubria profile in this series.
sections.identification: The original description establishes it as a distinct species.
sections.habitat: Its type region is the Rio Trombetas in Pará, Brazil.
sections.diet: FishBase does not list prey or feeding data for this species.
sections.behavior: FishBase provides no species-specific behavioral account.
sections.reproduction: The FishBase summary provides no breeding details.
sections.ecology: The description discusses relationships among small-scaled pike cichlids.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports an IUCN status of Least Concern, assessed in 2018.
